name: 15320-imageprefill-qwen3vl8b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, bf16, ~17 GB. Already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 3200 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm over /v1/chat/completions, single turn: ~128 tokens of synthetic prompt text (stdev 13) plus one 560x560 gradient JPEG at quality 85, byte-distinct per request. 324 image tokens after the 2x2 merge, exactly 32 output tokens with ignore_eos.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter multimodal assistant answering short questions about one uploaded photo for 32 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the reader takes this file line by line and DROPS nested or indented
# blocks, so a value re-flowed onto more than one line disappears and the engine starts without it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 4

enable-multimodal: true
attention-backend: fa3
mm-attention-backend: fa3

max-running-requests: 64
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
disable-radix-cache: true

disable-custom-all-reduce: true

error.text: the version before the PR crashes in a CUDA-graph mode our harness enables, and the only change that avoids it is not part of the source's launch
